resources.string: Local authentication
Import local identity
Imported identity saved on this device.
No user-imported identity on this device.
Local validation does not guarantee acceptance by an iPhone or vehicle.

Select identity.pk8, then the matching certificate.p7b from this device. Use only an identity you are authorized to use. Each file must be non-empty and at most 16 KiB. The existing identity is replaced only after both files pass local validation. The files are saved in private app storage and are not uploaded. Local validation does not guarantee acceptance by an iPhone or vehicle.
Choose identity.pk8
Choose certificate.p7b
Step 2 of 2: choose the matching certificate.p7b. The private key is staged only; your existing identity has not changed. Cancelling discards the staged files.
Reading the selected private key…
Checking the identity and certificate…
Finish or cancel the identity import before connecting.
Disconnect CarPlay before importing an identity. This includes a connection that is starting or stopping. Your current identity will not be replaced while a session is running.
Disconnect first
Disconnected. Tap Import local identity to begin.
Import cancelled. The previous identity was kept.
Import interrupted. Start again and select both files. No partial identity was installed.
Could not import these files. Choose a matching unencrypted P-256 PKCS#8 key and PKCS#7 certificate, each non-empty and at most 16 KiB. The previous identity was kept.
The system file picker could not be opened. The previous identity was kept.
Identity imported and local checks passed. You can now try connecting. Real-device acceptance still needs to be tested.
Identity saved, but authentication could not be started. Reopen DiPlay before connecting.
Import could not finish and authentication storage could not be restored. Reopen DiPlay before connecting.
